description: Set the Roto Brush & Refine Edge effect's settings on layers (Effect Controls panel): propagation (Search Radius, View Search Radius, Motion Threshold, Motion Damping, Edge Detection, Enable Classic Controls, Use Alternate Color Estimation), matte (Feather, Contrast, Shift Edge, Reduce Chatter, Smooth) for the Roto Brush or Refine Edge matte, and refinement (Fine-tune Refine Edge Matte, Extend Where Smoothed, Increase Radius, View Map). Settings are found by their English names. Segmentation strokes and propagation are done by hand with the Roto Brush and Refine Edge tools

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

effect.description: Which effect, by name or 1-based index in the Effect Controls panel; omit for every one of its kind on the layer

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

matte.description: Which matte group feather, contrast, shiftEdges, reduceChatter and smooth apply to. Default roto

properties.description: Any other setting of the effect by name or match name, to a number or true/false

edgeDetection.description: Edge Detection: position in its menu, from 1

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time

name: set_roto_brush
title: Set Roto Brush
